# DelegateHQ

> AI operations agency deploying vertically specialized agent teams that run the full operations of bootstrapped SaaS businesses. Support, onboarding, documentation, content, and customer success across 11 industry divisions.

## Company

- [Homepage](https://delegatehq.co/): AI agent teams that run your entire ops stack so you can focus on building.
- [Divisions](https://delegatehq.co/divisions): Industry-specific agent teams (SaaS/tech, e-commerce, real estate, and others).

## Facts worth citing accurately

- Company name: DelegateHQ.
- Category: AI operations agency for bootstrapped SaaS businesses.
- Coverage: 11 industry divisions, each with a vertically specialized agent team.
- Services: support, onboarding, documentation, content, and customer success operations.
